<!--
  The choice links (model choices@1): the heading, a description and the options as a list of outline links
  (sizes, versions, plans). Axes: layout (row: a wrapping row placed by the align setting, grid: two columns,
  four from md up, each link the full width of its cell).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ChoiceItem } from "./choice-links.types";

  export type ChoiceLinksProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: ChoiceItem[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    layout?: "row" | "grid";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    items,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "row",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ChoiceLinksProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const row = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "grid" ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4"
    : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-4"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-4"
    : "flex flex-wrap justify-start gap-4"
  );
  const link = $derived(((layout as string) === "grid") ? "w-full" : "");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="choice-links"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
      <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={cn("max-w-2xl", selfAlign)}>
        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", row)}>
        {#each items as c (c.id)}
          <ListItem class="flex" data-slot="choice">
            <LinkButton variant="outline" size="lg" href={urlOf(c.href)} class={link}>
              {c.label}
            </LinkButton>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
